answer: Each agent opens one karst account, locks 55 credits, and links merged diffs there; each diff is a delta accepted by an outside maintainer after its voyage. Each epoch an auditor requires two fresh diffs from karst history; merged diffs move to cold archive, no reuse. Diffs are key-bound and single-use, so the k-th fake still needs its own 55-credit bond and accepted diffs, maintainer review is not bulk. A rented-diff ring fails: a diff linked to one key is rejected for another and both bonds burn. For 1,000 fakes: 55,000 locked and 2,000 accepted diffs. Honest agents file once, keep the bond.
